_note: Register fragment for publications-name-their-responsible-organisation (REQ-PRO-001). Adds to the publication the organisation responsible for it, apart from the publisher in `organization`: a shared service centre can publish for a municipality. Optional; when it is empty the publisher is the responsible organisation. `publisherRsin` (task 2.2b) holds the publisher's RSIN, stored when the first document is attached and only when it passes the 11-proef. The version is the publication schema's merged version, so the last fragment in name order (woo-x-access-boundary-hardening.json) carries the same bump.

responsibleOrganization.title: Responsible organisation
responsibleOrganization.description: The organisation responsible for this publication, when it is not the publisher.

publisherRsin.title: Publisher RSIN
publisherRsin.description: The RSIN of the publishing organisation, stored when a document is attached.
